authorization_scope: Deterministic prospective-v9 semantic adjudication wrapper carried forward unchanged from v4, exact-span and route validation, auxiliary observer, action-before-register timing, production executor, endpoint, analyzer, power, and request-validator readiness only; this certificate authorizes no confirmation-model call, live study, or programme-headroom consumption.
launch_gate: v5 keeps the v4 instrument and earns no fresh accuracy claim from it: the sealed 55-case held-out v4 corpus is spent and permanently excluded, and the two byte moves since it was spent are each held by a zero-cost test named in the registration under measurement.semanticAdjudicator.instrumentProvenance. What v5 changes is the window and the loss rule. The trigger may now show by turn 4 rather than turn 2, and the outcome window is five post-trigger learner turns rather than two, so in every registered world at least two shortest-path premises are public before the last turn; under v4 no world released a second premise before turn 5 while dialogues ended at turn 3 or 4, which left only 11 of 33 objective zeros reachable. A pre-treatment turn the adjudicator cannot read is now passed over and the next turn is read, matching the resistance study; all three v4 losses were unreadable trigger turns and all three fell on the warm side. Launch still requires the wholly fresh digest-bound HOLD request with absent create-once destinations, exact digest verification against the standing authorization, prelaunch verification of the 4428-study and 15000-programme operational safeguards, and a separately committed explicit human approval. The completed v4 study, the stopped v2 cohort, and the spent v1-v4 validation corpora remain permanently excluded from every v5 outcome.
